purpose: Optional external VLM screenshot review; no service is called automatically.
questions: Does the 3D viewport contain a visible ellipsoid/head surface?
Are target and current projection curves distinguishable?
Are semantic rings attached to the visible surface?
Are obvious holes, spikes, or broken triangles visible?
limitations: Visual checks cannot establish solver optimality, hidden-constraint feasibility, or production topology quality. Numerical tests remain required.
